chunk-002:c002-01.proposition: Excluding causal loops requires irreflexivity together with a controversial transitivity principle, so the stated causal assumptions do not conclusively rule out loop-permitting theories.

orphanFallback.rationale: The proposition independently identifies the additional structural assumption needed to exclude causal loops and thereby limits the derivation of a first cause even without an earlier retained opposing move.

chunk-002:c002-05.proposition: The shared causal premises establish at least one uncaused cause but do not establish that exactly one first cause exists; uniqueness would require an additional premise.

orphanFallback.rationale: The proposition stands alone as a scope analysis of the causal premises, distinguishing existence from uniqueness and exposing a missing premise in any single-creator inference.

chunk-002:c002-08.proposition: A necessary initial natural state can explain the universe's beginning without a cause, while every later existent or occurrence remains causally explained through its evolution.

orphanFallback.rationale: This is Oppy's positive naturalist foundation: necessity explains the initial state and causal evolution explains subsequent reality, so the proposal advances independently of any earlier retained opposing move.

chunk-002:c002-10.proposition: On the necessary-initial-state theory, nothing enters natural reality except through the initial state or its causal evolution, so causeless later entities cannot simply appear.

orphanFallback.rationale: The proposition independently states a constraint of the naturalist theory that confines uncaused existence to the necessary initial state and excludes arbitrary later appearances.

chunk-003:c003-06.proposition: Changelessness requires an extension over which no change occurs; if that duration is infinite it restores a regress, while if finite it has a beginning.

orphanFallback.rationale: The duration dilemma is a self-contained coherence challenge to a beginningless changeless cause because either available measure conflicts with a required feature of that cause.

chunk-003:c003-10.proposition: A necessary initial-universe theory explains the same relevant facts with fewer entities, while adding a personal God supplies no compensating explanatory advantage.

orphanFallback.rationale: The proposition independently compares the complete rival theories by explanatory coverage and ontological economy, presenting the personal creator as an unnecessary addition without needing a prior reply target.

chunk-004:chunk-004-c08.proposition: A modal theory on which every possible world shares an initial history makes the actual initial state necessarily first, with worlds diverging only through later chance outcomes.

orphanFallback.rationale: This proposition supplies positive modal grounds for the initial state's necessity and exclusion of alternative beginnings, so it functions as an independent constructive component of Oppy's theory.

chunk-004:chunk-004-c10.proposition: Logical consistency does not establish metaphysical possibility, so consistently describable alternative universes do not by themselves undermine the initial state's metaphysical necessity.

orphanFallback.rationale: The logical-versus-metaphysical modality distinction is independently substantive and explains why conceivable consistent alternatives need not count against a necessary initial state.

chunk-005:c005-09.proposition: An instantaneous event occurring wholly at the universe's initial time need not have a distinct beginning, undermining the premise that every event begins.

orphanFallback.rationale: The initial-instant counterexample independently contests the universal claim that events have beginnings and preserves an event-based initial natural state without relying on an earlier opposing move.

chunk-006:chunk-006-candidate-04.proposition: Although Loke's assumptions entail a first cause outside the universe, Oppy's assumptions equally entail a first cause that belongs to the universe.

orphanFallback.rationale: The proposition independently establishes theoretical parity between an external creator foundation and a universe-internal first cause, directly supporting the con motion-level alternative.
